measure.evidenceText: Google Hotels identifies Travelodge Rathmines at Lower Rathmines Road Lower, Rathmines, Dublin as a 3-star hotel. It shows $119 nightly and $135 total for 1 night with taxes + fees, with a visible 2 Adults selector. The same evidence does not state one room.
measure.referencePeriod: Google Hotels result crawled 3 weeks ago; July 13–14 stay; 2-adult selector
measure.searchQuery: site:google.com/travel/hotels Dublin Ireland 3-star hotel 2 adults 1 room one night price taxes
measure.reason: Strict not_found because one room is not explicitly stated. Selector-relaxed found is a hypothesis label only: exact-city class, non-from nightly price, taxes, and a two-adult one-night selector are present, but this is not an observed two-person room quote.
